name: torch
note: CPU-only PyTorch build for the Karpathy LLM course workloads; queued 2026-11-15. The linux wheels on PyPI bundle the CUDA runtime (nvidia-* transitive pins, multi-GB image growth), so the candidate declares the pytorch-cpu index: uv resolves torch from download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu under a PEP 440 local tag (2.15.0+cpu, cp314 wheels confirmed) and the [tool.uv.sources] pin keeps later nightly lock upgrades on the CPU index. Requires the index-field support in check-upstream.yml (PR #392) to merge first; while that PR is open the nightly resolves this candidate from PyPI, which would produce the CUDA variant, so this PR should merge second.
